description: Defines a Flutter widget class 'NoteCard' that displays a note's summary including title, subtitle, and last updated date, with interactive tap and long-press actions.

classes.name: NoteCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that presents a note's title, a subtitle (first line of body or 'No details'), and last update date with tap and long press callbacks.

methods.name: _subtitle
methods.description: Returns the first line of the note body or 'No details' if empty.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for displaying the note card, including styling, layout, and event handlers.
